map_key.outer: first Class argument to ServiceMap.autoRegister, converted with Class.getName()

missing_behavior.module_only: requests dynamic module through listener and returns null without synchronous retry

replacement.autoRegister_release_init_false: last executed registration replaces same API+qualifier
replacement.Services_register: always replaces same API+qualifier and module mapping
replacement.unregister: removes all qualifiers and module mapping for service name

creation.default: first declared constructor of exact APIMeta implementation, accessible, zero arguments
creation.custom_lookup_creator: overrides APIMeta creator for that lookup

initialization.normal_path: BaseApplication -> Services.init(false) -> reflective Loader.init -> RouterEntry.init -> ServiceMapGen.init -> autoRegister
conditions: QFix may replace application, RouterEntry, or generated init bodies
reflection/init failure prevents some or all registrations
dynamic module request is asynchronous with respect to current lookup

classification.confirmed: constant API+qualifier, exact registration, packaged RouterEntry reachable
classification.conditional: QFix/replacement ordering or other explicit runtime condition
classification.candidate: dynamic key, unproven initialization, module-only mapping, or unresolved custom APICreator
classification.no_binding: nonempty constant qualifier has no exact key

rule_risks: normalizing empty registration key to default
assuming every generated map is initialized
modeling dynamic module request as synchronous return
propagating a service implementation to hosts without call-site key and state proof
